description: Zonas WiFi en el Departamento del Valle del Cauca is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. El presente conjunto de datos contiene un inventario georreferenciado de las zonas Wi-Fi públicas del Valle del Cauca, administradas por la Gobernación. La información incluye dirección exacta y coordenadas geográficas de cada punto de acceso. Coverage: Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are ubicación, valle del cauca, 2018, zonas, wi fi. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2024-08-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
